## Infosys AI, Cloud, and Productivity Updates

Infosys positions AI and cloud through Infosys Topaz for AI-first services and Infosys Cobalt for cloud transformation.

## AI Product Launches
- Infosys Topaz: AI-first suite of services, solutions, and platforms
- Generative AI services: Enterprise use cases across operations, customer service, and software engineering
- AI engineering accelerators: Tools to improve development productivity and modernization

## Productivity Updates
- Application maintenance automation to reduce run costs
- Cloud migration factories for faster modernization
- AI-enabled service desk and business operations workflows

## Enterprise Features
- Infosys Cobalt: Cloud services ecosystem for migration, modernization, and operations
- Responsible AI: Governance, security, and enterprise controls for AI adoption
- Global delivery: Scaled offshore/nearshore delivery and managed service operations
